cues.en: The reason why some of us respond so emotionally to media is because media helped shape us as kids.

cues.zh: 我们在电影里都有初恋，而《指环王》就是我的初恋之一。
cues.en: We all have a first love in movies, and the Lord of the Rings was one of mine.

cues.zh: 所以无论你在媒体消费上变得多么“成熟”，
cues.en: So no matter how "mature" you become in your consumption of media,

cues.zh: 你心里总有一部分不愿用成年人的眼光去看待童年的热爱，
cues.en: there's always going to be some part of you that desires not to see your childhood passions through the eyes of an adult,

cues.zh: 而是想重新找回儿时点燃我们热情的东西。
cues.en: but instead to recapture what ignited our passions as kids.

cues.zh: 但也许，既然我现在是个有闲钱的成年人了，
cues.en: But maybe, now that I'm an adult with an expendable income,

cues.zh: 我可以踏上旅程，去寻找我那些问题的答案，
cues.en: I can make a journey to find the answers to my questions,

cues.zh: 看看那份魔力是否还能被重新找回。
cues.en: And see if perhaps that magic can be recaptured.

cues.zh: “Lindsay，等等！”
cues.en: "Lindsay, wait!"

cues.zh: “回去吧，Nella！我要一个人去新西兰。”
cues.en: "Go back, Nella! I'm going to New Zealand alone."

cues.zh: “你当然会这么说。而我跟你一起去！”
cues.en: "Of course you are. And I'm coming with you!"
